domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 用于描述无界域或远场边界行为的数值离散单元。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道—土体等相互作用模型中，与土体有限元配合处理远场，使有限计算区域能够表示向无穷远延伸的介质；部分模型通过位移衰减和坐标映射描述远域行为。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P047.title: Vehicle–track–tunnel dynamic interaction: a finite/infinite element modelling method
P047.label: Xu等（2021）

complete_examples.text: The physical characteristics and mechanical behavior of tunnel segments and rings are modeled by the finite element method, while the soil layers of the vehicle–track–tunnel (VTT) system are modeled as an assemblage of 3-D mapping infinite elements by satis-fying the boundary conditions at the infinite area.
The soil around the tunnel is regarded as an elastic half-space, and mapping infinite elements are introduced to model the external boundary of tunnels and the far field vibration of the soil space.
